'''Jaeth''' was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who worked as a dockhand on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Pinett]] during the first [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Wizard" />
